description: This file defines the Config entity class for Doctrine ORM in a Human Resource Management system. It maps to the database table 'hs_hr_config' and provides getter and setter methods for the 'name' and 'value' properties.

classes.name: Config
classes.description: Entity class representing configuration entries in the database with 'name' as primary key and 'value' as the associated value.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name identifier of the configuration.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name identifier of the configuration.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Returns the value associated with the configuration.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Sets the value for the configuration.
